summary: Is She Really Going Out with Him? is the debut single by British musician Joe Jackson, released in September 1978. It was later reissued in 1979 and achieved greater commercial success at that time. The track was included on Jackson's debut album, Look Sharp!.
one_line: A 1978 debut single by British musician Joe Jackson, later reissued in 1979 for greater success, featured on his album Look Sharp!.
key_facts: "Is She Really Going Out with Him?" is the first single released by British musician Joe Jackson.
